Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614079 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical_smiles, and filter by assay CHEMBL1614079. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
